SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q15. Two coins are tossed simultaneously. The probability of getting at most one head is:
(a) 1/4
(b) 1/2
(c) 3/4
(d) 1

Answer / Solution:
Sample space: {HH, HT, TH, TT}
At most one head: {HT, TH, TT} => 3 outcomes
Probability = 3/4
Answer: (c) 3/4
